name: Rome
intro: Routes shaped by memory, craft, liturgy, and slow attention—from the Republic to Borromini.

name: Florence
tagline: Where beauty was made a civic project.
intro: Patronage, perspective, and the belief that a city could teach judgment through what it hung on its walls.

name: Venice
tagline: A republic that chose water, risk, and ornament.
intro: Beauty masking ambition; every canal a reminder that splendor can be a political choice.

name: Paris
tagline: Stone, light, and the long argument with modernity.
intro: From Gothic vertical will to the museum as a national memory palace.

name: Kyoto
intro: Temples, gardens, and the discipline of renewing form without discarding meaning.
